title: LouisAgent.Evals: the overview
caption: An eval file is read and its turns graded, and a run plays it against the agent over the sessions API, keeps itself as one file, and replays from its recording for free.

cards.title: LouisAgent.Evals
cards.text: How an agent is measured: an eval file of conversations, played and graded, kept as a run.

cards.title: The file is read
cards.text: One .eval.json becomes records, found beside its agent's prompts. A wrong one is refused at its first fault.

cards.title: A turn is graded
cards.text: Code tells seven facts from what happened, and a judge marks each criterion with its reason.

cards.title: A run is played
cards.text: Each conversation in a session of its own, as many repeats as asked; it stops when the harness fails.

cards.title: A run is kept and replayed
cards.text: One file per run. A live run records the agent's and the judge's answers, so a replay costs nothing.
